citation.section: Playing the Game > Combat > Unseen Attackers and Targets
citation.quote: When a creature can’t see you, you have Advantage on attack rolls against it.

citation.section: Playing the Game > Combat > Unseen Attackers and Targets
citation.quote: When you make an attack roll against a target you can’t see, you have Disadvantage on the roll. This is true whether you’re guessing the target’s location or targeting a creature you can hear but not see.
